production_edit: Only fppoly.evaluate body changes; prefix/suffix of polynomial.mbt are byte-identical.
invariant: Opaque coefficients, once-reduced point and each Horner accumulator lie below p; product is canonical; sum is below 2p, so one checked subtraction suffices.
constant_rationale: Empty and constant cases must precede point reduction; arbitrary huge point has no effect on their value and previously needed no expensive normalization.
shared_checker_limit: listdecode.check_candidate calls encode, which calls fppoly.evaluate. Checker success alone is not independent evidence for Horner arithmetic; the fixture and tests additionally use host Int64 oracle values and retain generic legacy arithmetic.
